task: Make lattice check explain exactly which root managed asset paths are relative to when metadata root and gitRoot differ.
outcome: After completion, a ClawCreek-style user runs lattice check or lattice check --json and sees that .gitignore/.codex relPath values are rooted at the metadata asset root, with the configured gitRoot shown separately when it differs.
facts: runManagedAssetCheck currently accepts a root argument and applies managed assets relative to that root.
ManagedAssetCheckResult currently returns profile, assetMode, items, applied paths, summary, and manifestPath but no root diagnostics.
ClawCreek has a wrapper-root shape where Lattice metadata root and configured gitRoot are different directories.
Prior stories B-1637/B-75f0 fixed git command cwd selection; this story is about check output and result shape, not git execution.
constraints: Do not move managed asset writes from metadata root to gitRoot.
Keep relPath and applied path semantics backward compatible.
Expose root diagnostics in both JSON and human text output.
Add regression coverage for wrapper-root metadataRoot != gitRoot.
Do not run lattice check --apply against external ClawCreek as part of this code story.
